actual_task_instruction: I maintain my work schedule in SimpleNote and track my tasks in Todoist. Every night, I delete the completed tasks from my "Today's Target" project. Then, I move the maximum number of incomplete tasks from my Inbox to the "Today's Target" project. The maximum here is assuming I work back-to-back as per my schedule and I find time for the left overs from the current day first. I am busy tonight, please do it for me. Note that the moved tasks must be identical to the original ones.

agents.actual_task_instruction: I maintain my work schedule in SimpleNote and track my tasks in Todoist. Every night, I delete the completed tasks from my "Today's Target" project. Then, I move the maximum number of incomplete tasks from my Inbox to the "Today's Target" project. Note that the moved tasks must be identical to the original ones.
released_registered_requirements: assert answers match.
assert model changes match todoist.Task

assert the removed tasks' project_id are
in private_data.inbox_project_id or private_data.goal_project_id.
assert the added tasks' project_id matches private_data.goal_project_id.
assert all added tasks have the same priority as private_data.priority

obtain added, updated, removed todoist.Task records using models.changed_records,
and assert updated tasks have only changed at most in the order_index field.

assert the removed tasks' IDs match
private_data.to_delete_inbox_task_ids + private_data.to_delete_goal_task_ids.

assert the task_title_to_descriptions obtained from the added tasks match
private_data.to_delete_task_title_to_descriptions (normalize_text).

assert the task_title_to_minutes obtained from the added tasks match
private_data.to_delete_task_title_to_minutes (normalize_text).
